subject: feat: add integration tests for expired hashes and FT.INFO parser (#311)
reason: The change only adds Python integration tests and a test-suite FT.INFO parser (ft_info_parser.py, test_expired.py, refactors of test_cancel.py/test_flushall.py/indexes.py) plus a CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM export in build.sh. No module source code under src/ changed, so the module's runtime behavior (FT.INFO replies, expired-hash index removal, FLUSHALL handling) is identical on both builds; there is no changed server-side path for a scenario to exercise.
